from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,sys,json
S=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\Desktop\QASCP\public-review-20261125")
O=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\AppData\Local\Temp\qascp-re-audit-20261126-5919d022")
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
marker="QASCP-NONSECRET-FINAL-PASS2"
cases=[]
def run_case(label,key=None,directive=None,malformed=False,linked=False,expected=1):
 repo=O/("08-probe-"+label);repo.mkdir()
 def git(*args,cwd=None,check=True):
  return subprocess.run(["git",*args],cwd=cwd or repo,env=env,capture_output=True,check=check)
 git("init","--quiet");git("config","--local","extensions.worktreeConfig","true")
 target=repo
 if linked:
  git("-c","user.name=QASCP Synthetic","-c","user.email=synthetic@example.invalid","-c","commit.gpgsign=false","commit","--allow-empty","-m","Disposable synthetic worktree test")
  target=repo/"linked";git("worktree","add","--detach",str(target))
 if key:git("config","--worktree",key,marker,cwd=target)
 if directive:
  inc=repo/"nonsecret-include.config";git("config","--file",str(inc),"credential.helper",marker)
  git("config","--worktree",directive,str(inc),cwd=target)
 if malformed:
  config=git("rev-parse","--git-path","config.worktree",cwd=target).stdout.decode().strip()
  p=Path(config);p=p if p.is_absolute() else target/p
  p.write_text("["+marker,encoding="utf-8")
 if label in ("benign","linked-benign"):git("config","--worktree","user.name","Synthetic reviewer",cwd=target)
 names=git("config","--show-scope","--name-only","--list",cwd=target,check=False)
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(S/"scripts/verify_checkout_auth.py")],cwd=target,env=env,capture_output=True)
 item=dict(label=label,expected_exit=expected,guard_exit=r.returncode,key=key,directive=directive,effective_name_inspection_exit=names.returncode,marker_exposed=marker.encode() in r.stdout+r.stderr,stdout=r.stdout.decode().strip(),stderr=r.stderr.decode().strip())
 if key:item["effective_key_confirmed"]=key.lower() in names.stdout.decode().lower()
 assert r.returncode==expected,item
 assert not item["marker_exposed"],item
 cases.append(item)
for key in ("credential.helper","credential.https://example.invalid.helper","http.extraheader","http.https://example.invalid/.extraheader","core.sshCommand"):
 run_case(key.replace(".","-").replace(":","_").replace("/","_"),key=key)
run_case("benign",expected=0)
run_case("include",directive="include.path")
run_case("inactive-include",directive="includeIf.gitdir:/qascp-never-match/.path")
run_case("case-insensitive-conditional",directive="includeIf.gitdir/i:**/08-PROBE-CASE-INSENSITIVE-CONDITIONAL/.git.path")
run_case("malformed",malformed=True)
run_case("linked-benign",linked=True,expected=0)
run_case("linked-auth",linked=True,key="credential.helper")
run_case("linked-include",linked=True,directive="include.path")
(O/"08-independent-worktree-probes.json").write_text(json.dumps(cases,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(cases,indent=2))
